notes: Per-(slug, shape_point) large-shape argv overrides for the portable_lcd CUPTI duration driver (collect_portable_lcd_duration.py). This file is the driver's explicit ALLOWLIST: a portable cell is collected for a dual-source duration label ONLY if it has an entry here; otherwise the driver fails closed with missing_large_shape_override, because a fixed tiny shape cannot satisfy the dual-source 5%-relative reconciliation bound (host enqueue/sync overhead dominates short kernels). The entries are LARGE SINGLE-KERNEL shapes that reconcile on the live RTX 5060 (sm_120): the flash_attn (fwd/bwd) and GEMM (hmma_bf16/hmma_fp16/imma_int8) portable runners honor their size overrides (--BH/--Sq/--Sk/--D for flash-shaped; --m/--n/--k for GEMM-shaped) to produce a single multi-ms kernel whose CUPTI device span equals the host cudaEvent span to ~0% (dual_source_reconciliation_passed=true). Two shape_points per slug (trace_l2_accuracy_lg ~6-8ms, trace_l2_accuracy_xl ~60-80ms) give within-slug shape variation for the duration predictor. conv2d|timing_shape is retained as a live NEGATIVE witness: its shape pins a small kernel and does NOT consume the GEMM override, so the reconciliation gate correctly EXCLUDES it (duration_dual_source_reconciliation_failed). Slugs whose runners do NOT honor the override (swiglu/silu/softmax/gemm_sparse_2to4) stay sub-ms and are catalogued as non-reconcilers in duration_candidate_diagnostic.json, not listed here.
